'''2011 Tatooine Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 10 July 2011, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2011 Tatooine Regionals.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Site:''' Valhalla's Games, Wheat Ridge, Colorado
* '''Dates:''' 10 July 2011
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
